name: KubeCafé — Fundamentos de Kubernetes (CNCF Medellín)
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture); curl -fsSLo /tmp/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/latest/kind-linux-${ARCH} && chmod +x /tmp/kind && sudo mv /tmp/kind /usr/local/bin/kind && K9S_ARCH=$([ "$ARCH" = "amd64" ] && echo "amd64" || echo "arm64"); curl -fsSL https://github.com/derailed/k9s/releases/latest/download/k9s_Linux_${K9S_ARCH}.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin k9s && chmod +x scripts/verificar-reto.sh'
